notes: A full adversarial audit of the whole application — 43 agents across eight domains, every finding put to an independent verifier told to refute it — and everything it confirmed. MONEY: a withholding cheque covering more than one payment could never be reversed (the guard refused a partial reversal, then refused every alternative too); the VAT 'record the missing cheque' button always passed a zero amount, so it recorded nothing and said it had worked, leaving the remittance out of every later bank reconciliation; a reversed vendor bill still offered Pay and Debit note against a payable the ledger no longer carried, with Edit and Post hidden; a debit note reversed the VAT share today's settings give rather than the share the bill actually claimed. DATES: PAYE/SSNIT/Tier-2/Tier-3, VAT and the tourism levy each gained a Date paid field — all three used to stamp today on both the voucher and the cheque; six more screens now file entries in the period their own date falls in; the statement import clears each item on the date of the line that cleared it. FINDING THINGS: searching Payments and Receipts now reads the whole ledger instead of filtering the newest 300 and answering 'No payments match'; three real bank-statement layouts were being misread, including one that offered to clear the wrong half of the reconciliation; an unreadable date column now yields no closing balance and says so rather than filling in a wrong one; the import names every item it is about to clear; uncredited lodgements finally exist — nothing ever created one, so that half of the reconciliation was 0.00 by construction while the screen said the register filled itself. BACKUPS: dated by the name rather than the file, so copying a folder no longer re-dates every backup and prunes the newest; the wrong-company guard checks the short name as well as the full name; a restore re-asserts database privileges; the off-site folder is checked for sitting inside the app's own data directory. Backup settings can no longer be changed except by an administrator, and the renderer is barred from reaching the network at all. Every fix is covered by a test checked against the defect itself.
